bead.title: Land ADR-013: the log is the single source of truth; relational projections become rebuildable views
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Two contradictory durability contracts share the pqueue-postgres crate: log-authoritative (lib.rs:6-13) vs DB-authoritative (relational.rs:3,983-987,2767 — "pqueue_items is DB-authoritative", "nothing to replay"). This blocks branch-at-position, read-as-of-position, and change-record emission guarantees for the relational family. Operator decision (2026-07-03): the log is the system of truth, period; the Postgres projection is just another projection; a null-log mode may exist with expected, documented functionality loss.

CURRENT STATE
Draft ADR exists at docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-013-log-single-source-of-truth.md (status Proposed). ADR-001:123-130 already states the intent; ADR-008 legitimized the drift as "two projection families."

PROPOSED FIX
Review, finalize, and mark ADR-013 accepted: relational family becomes a materialized cache with persisted applied-high-water, must implement recovery_high_water + tail replay, "authoritative" language retired; null-log mode documented as named/telemetry-surfaced degraded configuration with the five enumerated losses. Add amendment notes to ADR-001 and ADR-008 pointing at ADR-013. Code migration of relational.rs is follow-up work derived from the accepted ADR, not this bead.

NON-SCOPE
- relational.rs code migration (file follow-up beads after acceptance).
- Implementing null-log mode.
bead.acceptance:
1. docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-013-log-single-source-of-truth.md finalized with Status: Accepted, stating the relational-projection change and the five null-log losses (no replay, no branch, no read-as-of, no emission guarantee, weakened idempotency recovery).
2. ADR-001 and ADR-008 carry amendment cross-references to ADR-013.
3. Follow-up implementation beads for the relational rebuild-from-log migration are listed in the ADR as derived work (not filed by this bead).
4. Repo docs checks pass.
